subject: Vendor registration & PO mapping for Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Elena Markov <elena.markov@syscorps.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@syscorps.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 20:12:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor registration & PO mapping for Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / Laura,

We're starting vendor enrollment for Redwood so AP can route POs and match invoices. To get you set up in our vendor registry we need the following:

- Legal name as it should appear on invoices and our vendor record
- Tax documentation: W-9 for US entities or EU VAT registration evidence for EU entities
- Bank details (beneficiary name, account number, IBAN/SWIFT) + remittance instructions
- Preferred invoice format (PDF + UBL/CSV preferred for our platform)
- How you want PO matching handled (PO number on invoice header, PO line mapping field name)
- Any special billing contacts and contact emails for discrepancies/escalations

Attached is our vendor request form (Syscorps_Vendor_Request_Form.pdf) and a short mapping template (see later). Can you return the completed packet and a sample invoice so we can validate automated matching rules?

Net terms for this program are 60 days (standard). If you have a pre-existing negotiated term or need early payment support we can flag for review but will need a PO/contract reference.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Markov
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Syscorps Technologies
elena.markov@syscorps.com
[Attachment: Syscorps_Vendor_Request_Form.pdf]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO mapping for Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and attached files:

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax docs: Attached is our completed W-9 and a bank detail form (Redwood_W9_and_bank_form.pdf) — if you need an EU VAT certificate we can provide the VAT number and evidence (we operate through our EU entity).
- Bank details: included on the bank form; remittance address is payments@redwoodinference.com
- Invoice format: We can issue PDF invoices and export a UBL XML alongside. Attaching a Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx to show header/line structure.
- PO matching: We recommend the PO number be present in both the invoice header and in a custom invoice field labeled "external_reference" (that maps to your PO ID). If your mapping requires a different field name we can adopt it — just send the mapping CSV.

Proposed next steps:
1) We attach AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.xlsx which contains our standard fields.
2) You test one sample invoice against your matcher and send back the validation results.
3) Once live, we will send daily/weekly CSVs to your AP inbox if preferred.

Let us know if Syscorps requires a self-billing agreement or a specific reverse-charge note for EU VAT. Karthik is copied for VAT/evidence.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
[Attachments: Redwood_W9_and_bank_form.pdf, AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.xlsx, Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx]

Elena / Marcus —

A couple of clarifications from our side that help prevent holdbacks during matching:

- Invoice header must include: Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal name), Invoice Date, Invoice #, PO #, Billing Contact (name + email), and "external_reference" as a searchable field if possible.
- For EU invoices where VAT is not charged (reverse charge), include the standard wording: "Reverse charge – VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194 of Directive 2006/112/EC" or your country-specific language.
- If Syscorps prefers self-billing, please send the self-billing enrollment form — we can sign and return.
- For ACH/SEPA setup we will provide a bank confirmation (PDF) and an additional KYC stub if required by your finance team.

I've attached our AP onboarding workbook with a mapping sheet labeled "Syscorps_mapping" — fill the columns there with your required target fields. That will let us generate a matching invoice that passes your automated rules.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.xlsx]

This looks good. A couple of operational items before we close the ticket:

- Please send future invoices to ap-invoices@syscorps.com (PDF + UBL XML). Our matching engine consumes PDF for human review and UBL XML for line-level matching.
- I've attached Syscorps_PO_Mapping_Template.csv: please populate the "source_field" values to indicate how you name the PO field on your invoice (e.g., "external_reference", "po_number").
- Once we validate one sample invoice we will promote Redwood to our production vendor roster and issue POs from next cycle.

If you can return the mapping CSV and one signed bank confirmation by end of week we should be live for May POs.
